description: After credit_bill and the wallet's signature: the header the merchant reads (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, or X-PAYMENT for x402 version 1), base64 JSON with the authorization and signature. Reads no chain and sends nothing: checks the authorization against the bill (the merchant's payTo, exactly its amount, not run out) and recovers a 65-byte signature to its payer. Send the same request again with header.name set to header.value.

authorization.description: The authorization credit_bill returned, as it returned it

payment_required.description: The same payment_required given to credit_bill

signature.description: The wallet's signature of credit_bill's typed_data (0x hex)

name: credit_bill_header
title: The x402 payment header for a signed bill
